title: A deposit paid on the portal after Convert to No Charge is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a portal contact for this test for customer A, whose portal login the tester can use, and a test card.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billable, sent to the portal with a deposit request.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in to the customer portal as customer A's contact.
  2. Open the deposit checkout of work order 1.
  3. In ShopView, convert work order 1 to No Charge under Goodwill.
  4. In the portal, pay the deposit with the test card.
  5. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The portal opens.

Step 2:

  • The checkout shows.

Step 3:

  • Work order 1 shows the "No Charge" badge.

Step 4:

  • The deposit is refused with "Deposits are not available on internal or no-charge work orders."

Step 5:

  • The refused deposit is recorded with its own reason and the existing refund action is offered.
